dct_description_sm: Schedule "G" to this Plan identifies areas for which Secondary Plans Areas have been prepared or are proposed to be prepared. The Secondary Plans implement and adapt the direction of the General Plan in response to the specific circumstances of individual planning districts. In many cases, the policies of Secondary Plans will be more detailed and/or restrictive, but consistent with the policies of the General Plan.
dct_title_s: Official Plan Schedule G Secondary Plan Areas
